quote: We proposed to automate annotations of text data with continuous labels with BWS, which outperforms rating scales and paired comparisons in the case of emotion intensity predictions...
outputs: continuous value labels for emotion intensity

quote: Each tuple was annotated by 3-4 independent workers on the crowd-sourcing platform Crowdflower.
guideline: Annotators are provided an n-tuple (typically n = 4) of data-points and asked to choose the best and worst of the tuple, given the scale they are annotating.
